name: Pusparani Patel/ ପୁଷ୍ପରାଣୀ ପଟେଲ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pusparani Patel writes Odia poetry and short fiction. Reports of Rourkela literary gatherings record her sharing stories with fellow writers. Her short-story collection Sunyapharda, published by Black Eagle Books in 2025, continues this interest in the emotional textures of everyday life; its author’s note speaks of learning to live with loss, loneliness and renewal.

In ‘କଵି ଓ କବିତା’, the poet becomes a figure who can bring rain without monsoon clouds and awaken feeling in desert sand. Tears, flowers and a dreamed Taj Mahal draw writing and love close together. The poem imagines poetry as a sustaining presence, able to give an unfinished life another chance to bloom.
